exposure: balloon occlusion of internal iliac arteries
cohort: 114 women with placenta previa and pathologically confirmed accreta
finding: Balloon occlusion of internal iliac arteries during cesarean hysterectomy in women with placenta previa accreta was not associated with improved maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Balloon occlusion of internal iliac arteries during cesarean hysterectomy in women with placenta previa accreta was not associated with improved maternal outcomes.
